fnol_text: My name is Ines Nguyen-Tran and I live at 583 Hawthorn Street, Dover, DE 19937. You can reach me on (555) 254-1898 or ines.nguyentran@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 8 January 2024. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2023-00089. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Nguyen-Tran on (555) 254-1898 to acknowledge the claim. Ines confirmed the loss date as 8 January 2024.
Site visit to 583 Hawthorn Street. Neighbour Bianca Santos was present and confirmed the timeline.
Ines sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
